violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MILK AT 45F AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF MILK DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED FOR COLD HOLDING UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURE BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED 1-DOOR UPR COOLER AT 34F- 51F ON DIGITAL THERMOMETER; UNIT OBSERVED AT 46F-49F WITH EHS THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC CALLED TECHNICIAN DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS CATERED FOODS OR FROZEN TCS FOODS OR NON-TCS FOODS MAY ONLY BE SERVED IN THE MEANTIME. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED FOR COLD HOLDING UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURE BETWEEN 34-38F.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the DISHWASHING MACHINE with a concentration of LESS THAN 50 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. PLEASE ENSURE DISHWASH MACHINE IS NOT USED TO SANITIZE DISHES AND UTENSILS. ENSURE THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK IS USED FOR SANITIZING DISHES AND UTENSILS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PRECOOKED CHICKEN AT 119-128F IN HOT HOLDING UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE CHICKEN REHEATED TO 165F OR ABOVE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CUT LETTUCE AT 71F ON COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RETURNED LETTUCE TO REFRIGERATOR. EHS ALSO DISCUSSED USING TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL WITH A START TEMPERATURE OF 41F AND PROPER DOCUMENTATION.
